1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium to perform said computing.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the current step is based on a comparison of temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions with temporal sequences of the document actions.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is performed only after confirmation that the demonstrated user actions match the document actions within a threshold confidence level.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting includes visual emphasis distinct from other steps in the documented procedure.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the next step is predictive based on a pattern of user behavior derived from the alignment.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is conditional upon the user completing the current step.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the user interface automatically advances to display the next step only upon detection of completion of the current step.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, wherein the common strings are extracted through semantic analysis of user interface elements and procedure text.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and weighted according to similarity to current demonstrated user actions.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor parses structured or semi-structured procedure documents to identify discrete actionable steps.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device comprising a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein the alignment device, highlighting device, and scrolling device are implemented as software components executing on a computing device, and wherein the computing device includes a display for rendering the user interface.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, wherein the alignment device performs image analysis to extract action parameters from the captured images.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences are retrieved from a historical database of user interaction logs.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step includes comparing temporal characteristics of the demonstrated user actions with temporal characteristics of the document actions.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is applied only after the alignment exceeds a predetermined confidence threshold.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step includes predictive analysis of user behavior patterns.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is conditional upon completion of the current step.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, wherein the common strings are identified through semantic text analysis.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, wherein the computing step includes extracting action parameters from the captured images through image processing.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences are accessed from a stored database of historical user interactions.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extracting step includes parsing procedure documents to identify discrete actionable steps.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program instructions are stored on a non-transitory computer-readable medium.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein the computing, highlighting, and scrolling steps are implemented as software operations executed on a computing device.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, wherein the computing step includes performing image analysis to extract action parameters.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences are retrieved from a historical database.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program instructions are stored on a non-transitory computer-readable medium.
